The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] '''Oo Wen''' was owned as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Wen was a [[Garden/Legends|gardener]] and, together with several other Ho'Din [[Tree/Legends|foresters]], populated Besadii's luxurious if notorious indoor [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] with exotic and dangerous [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. In 32 BBY, while working on the garden construction project, Wen defied his owner by not reporting the location of a group of [[Ghostling]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] who had escaped from the Hutt's captivity [[Prison/Legends|cells]] and whom the Ho'Din gardener helped to hide within the garden.

==Biography==
[[File:Ghostling_child.jpg|thumb|right|upright|Oo Wen helped the Ghostling Princess, Arawynne, hide from Gardulla the Hutt.]]
Oo Wen was a tall, [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. His skin was bright green and his fleshy tendril 'hair' was violet in color. Although a [[Garden/Legends|gardener]] by profession, by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] he'd been purchased as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii]].<ref name="EA7" /> A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], Gardulla commissioned an underground [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|her fortress]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="EA5 ">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref> Wen was one of several Ho'Din responsible for cultivating and maintaining the garden, which contained the diverse terrains of [[Swamp/Legends|swampland]], [[Tree/Legends|forest]], [[Water/Legends|waterfalls]], and a lake, and was populated with many dangerous [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] flora and fauna.<ref name="EA7" /> The Ho'Din foresters worked for a full season to prepare the garden with [[Plant/Legends|flowers]] and trees.<ref name="EA5 " />

The garden was also to contain various sentient beings as ornaments. To that end, the Besadii Hutt had several [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]] released into the garden to serve as sources of illumination.<ref name="EA7" /> Similarly, in 32 BBY, Gardulla's thugs captured a group of diminutive [[Ghostling]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]], which included their [[Princess/Legends|Princess]], [[Arawynne]], for use as garden ornaments.<ref name="EA5 " /> Arawynne and the Ghostlings were broken out of their [[Prison/Legends|cells]] by some Tatooine children, all slaves themselves&mdash;[[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Pala Kwi'teksa]]&mdash;but soon returned to hide in the partially completed pleasure garden until the local children could organize a break-out from Besadii's compound. Wen and his fellow Ho'Din were known to Banai, who was also enslaved to Gardulla, and the boy was confident that the Ho'Din gardeners would protect the Ghostling children.<ref name="EA5 " />

Wen lived up to Banai's expectations; as a nature lover—derisively called a "flower lover" by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], who'd originally enslaved the Ghostlings for Gardulla—he was prepared to protect the Princess and her companions from the Hutt and her henchmen. At one point, while Wen was working with a small sapling, he saw Arawynne and two companions, Kwi'teksa and a [[Unidentified Wistie (Pala's scout)|Wistie]], across an open clearing. Wen waved the children forward, indicating that it was safe for them to cross the meadow. The Ghostling children, together with Kwi'teksa and several Wisties, took refuge in a cave in the garden. Wen was aware of that location, and the [[Unidentified Wistie (Arawynne's lookout)|Wistie lookouts]] were prepared to let the Ho'Din visit the children.<ref name="EA7" /> Eventually, Arawynne and her companions successfully escaped the compound.<ref name="EA8">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Wen, like many Ho'Din, was a lover of nature, and worked as a gardener. He was prepared to defy his owner, Gardulla Besadii the Elder, and do anything to protect the Ghostling children in his garden.<ref name="EA7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oo Wen was created by [[Dave Wolverton]] for ''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]'', published by [[Scholastic]] in [[2000]]. Each installment in the young adults' [[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures|''Episode I Adventures'']] series came with two books. One was a regular story book; the other was a game book that provided the reader with interactive choices to determine the outcome of the adventure. It is only the story book that mentions Oo Wen. Both the story book and the accompanying [[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne|game book]] mention another, [[Unidentified Ho'Din gardener|unidentified Ho'Din]]. Those sections are told from the perspective of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], who does not know the Ho'Din's name. It is therefore possible that this unnamed Ho'Din is also intended to be Wen; however, as there are multiple Ho'Din gardeners working for Besadii, this article treats the two as separate individuals.
